reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1977 i, book 35, باب نَهْيِ مَنْ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ عَشْرُ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ وَهُوَ مُرِيدُ التَّضْحِيَةِ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ مِنْ شَعْرِهِ أَوْ أَظْفَارِهِ شَيْئًا
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَخِي ابْنِ وَهْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي حَيْوَةُ، أَخْبَرَنِي خَالِدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ الْجُنْدَعِيِّ أَنَّ ابْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَتْهُ ‏.‏ وَذَكَرَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
en_text: And Harmalah ibn Yahya and Ahmad ibn Abd ar-Rahman ibn Akhi Ibn Wahb narrated to me—both saying: Abdallah ibn Wahb narrated to us: Haywah informed me: Khalid ibn Yazid informed me, from Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal, from Umar ibn Muslim al-Junda'i, that Ibn al-Musayyab informed him that Umm Salamah, wife of the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), informed him... and he mentioned from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) with the meaning of their hadith.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1978 a, book 35, باب تَحْرِيمِ الذَّبْحِ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَلَعْنِ فَاعِلِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَسُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مَرْوَانَ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ الْفَزَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الطُّفَيْلِ، عَامِرُ بْنُ وَاثِلَةَ قَالَ كُنْتُ عِنْدَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ مَا كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُسِرُّ إِلَيْكَ قَالَ فَغَضِبَ وَقَالَ مَا كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُسِرُّ إِلَىَّ شَيْئًا يَكْتُمُهُ النَّاسَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَدْ حَدَّثَنِي بِكَلِمَاتٍ أَرْبَعٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ مَا هُنَّ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ قَالَ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ لَعَنَ وَالِدَهُ وَلَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ ذَبَحَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ وَلَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ آوَى مُحْدِثًا وَلَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ غَيَّرَ مَنَارَ الأَرْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Surayj ibn Yunus narrated to us—both from Marwan; Zuhayr said: Marwan ibn Mu'awiyah al-Fazari narrated to us: Mansur ibn Hayyan narrated to us: Abu at-Tufayl Amir ibn Wathilah narrated to us, who said: I was with Ali ibn Abi Talib when a man came to him and said: "What did the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) use to confide to you in secret?" He said: He became angry and said: "The Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) never confided anything to me that he concealed from the people, except that he related to me four statements." He said: The man said: "What are they, O Commander of the Believers?" He said: He said: "May Allah curse whoever curses his parent; may Allah curse whoever slaughters to other than Allah; may Allah curse whoever harbors an innovator; and may Allah curse whoever alters the boundary markers of the land."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1978 b, book 35, باب تَحْرِيمِ الذَّبْحِ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَلَعْنِ فَاعِلِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ، بْنِ حَيَّانَ عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ، قَالَ قُلْنَا لِعَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ أَخْبِرْنَا بِشَىْءٍ، أَسَرَّهُ إِلَيْكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ مَا أَسَرَّ إِلَىَّ شَيْئًا كَتَمَهُ النَّاسَ وَلَكِنِّي سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ ذَبَحَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ وَلَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ آوَى مُحْدِثًا وَلَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ لَعَنَ وَالِدَيْهِ وَلَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ غَيَّرَ الْمَنَارَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: Abu Khalid al-Ahmar, Sulayman ibn Hayyan narrated to us, from Mansur ibn Hayyan, from Abu at-Tufayl, who said: We said to Ali ibn Abi Talib: "Inform us of something that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) confided to you." He said: "He did not confide anything to me that he concealed from the people, but I heard him saying: 'May Allah curse whoever slaughters to other than Allah; may Allah curse whoever harbors an innovator; may Allah curse whoever curses his parents; and may Allah curse whoever changes the boundary markers.'"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1978 c, book 35, باب تَحْرِيمِ الذَّبْحِ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَلَعْنِ فَاعِلِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ أَبِي بَزَّةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ، قَالَ سُئِلَ عَلِيٌّ أَخَصَّكُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِشَىْءٍ فَقَالَ مَا خَصَّنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِشَىْءٍ لَمْ يَعُمَّ بِهِ النَّاسَ كَافَّةً إِلاَّ مَا كَانَ فِي قِرَابِ سَيْفِي هَذَا - قَالَ - فَأَخْرَجَ صَحِيفَةً مَكْتُوبٌ فِيهَا ‏"‏ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ ذَبَحَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ وَلَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ سَرَقَ مَنَارَ الأَرْضِ وَلَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ لَعَنَ وَالِدَهُ وَلَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ آوَى مُحْدِثًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us—and the wording is Ibn al-Muthanna's—they said: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, who said: I heard al-Qasim ibn Abi Bazzah narrating from Abu at-Tufayl, who said: Ali was asked: "Did the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) single you out for anything?" He said: "The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) did not single us out for anything that he did not make common to all the people, except for what is in this sheath of my sword." He said: So he brought out a document in which was written: "May Allah curse whoever slaughters to other than Allah; may Allah curse whoever steals the boundary markers of the land; may Allah curse whoever curses his parent; and may Allah curse whoever harbors an innovator."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1979 a, book 36, باب تَحْرِيمِ الْخَمْرِ وَبَيَانِ أَنَّهَا تَكُونُ مِنْ عَصِيرِ الْعِنَبِ وَمِنَ التَّمْرِ وَالْبُسْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ وَغَيْرِهَا مِمَّا يُسْكِرُ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، قَالَ أَصَبْتُ شَارِفًا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَغْنَمٍ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ وَأَعْطَانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَارِفًا أُخْرَى فَأَنَخْتُهُمَا يَوْمًا عِنْدَ بَابِ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَحْمِلَ عَلَيْهِمَا إِذْخِرًا لأَبِيعَهُ وَمَعِيَ صَائِغٌ مِنْ بَنِي قَيْنُقَاعَ فَأَسْتَعِينَ بِهِ عَلَى وَلِيمَةِ فَاطِمَةَ وَحَمْزَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ يَشْرَبُ فِي ذَلِكَ الْبَيْتِ مَعَهُ قَيْنَةٌ تُغَنِّيهِ فَقَالَتْ أَلاَ يَا حَمْزَ لِلشُّرُفِ النِّوَاءِ فَثَارَ إِلَيْهِمَا حَمْزَةُ بِالسَّيْفِ فَجَبَّ أَسْنِمَتَهُمَا وَبَقَرَ خَوَاصِرَهُمَا ثُمَّ أَخَذَ مِنْ أَكْبَادِهِمَا ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ شِهَابٍ وَمِنَ السَّنَامِ قَالَ قَدْ جَبَّ أَسْنِمَتَهُمَا فَذَهَبَ بِهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَى مَنْظَرٍ أَفْظَعَنِي فَأَتَيْتُ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعِنْدَهُ زَيْدُ بْنُ حَارِثَةَ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ الْخَبَرَ فَخَرَجَ وَمَعَهُ زَيْدٌ وَانْطَلَقْتُ مَعَهُ فَدَخَلَ عَلَى حَمْزَةَ فَتَغَيَّظَ عَلَيْهِ فَرَفَعَ حَمْزَةُ بَصَرَهُ فَقَالَ هَلْ أَنْتُمْ إِلاَّ عَبِيدٌ لآبَائِي فَرَجَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُقَهْقِرُ حَتَّى خَرَجَ عَنْهُمْ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya at-Tamimi narrated to us: Hajjaj ibn Muhammad informed us, from Ibn Jurayj: Ibn Shihab narrated to me, from Ali ibn Husayn ibn Ali, from his father, Husayn ibn Ali, from Ali ibn Abi Talib, who said: I obtained an old she-camel along with the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) in the booty on the day of Badr, and the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) gave me another old she-camel. One day, I made them kneel at the door of a man of the Ansar while intending to carry idhkhir grass on them to sell it, having with me a goldsmith from Banu Qaynuqa', in order to help me with the feast for Fatimah. Meanwhile, Hamzah ibn Abd al-Muttalib was drinking in that house, accompanied by a singing-girl who sang to him, saying: "O Hamzah, come upon the plump she-camels!" So Hamzah leapt toward them with the sword, chopped off their humps, slashed open their flanks, and took from their livers. I said to Ibn Shihab: "And from the hump?" He said: "He chopped off their humps and took them away." Ibn Shihab said: Ali said: "I looked at a sight that horrified me, so I came to the Prophet of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), while Zayd ibn Harithah was with him, and informed him of the news. He came out with Zayd, and I went along with him. He entered upon Hamzah and showed anger towards him, but Hamzah raised his eyes and said: 'Are you anything other than slaves to my fathers?' So the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) stepped back, retreating backwards until he left them."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1979 b, book 36, باب تَحْرِيمِ الْخَمْرِ وَبَيَانِ أَنَّهَا تَكُونُ مِنْ عَصِيرِ الْعِنَبِ وَمِنَ التَّمْرِ وَالْبُسْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ وَغَيْرِهَا مِمَّا يُسْكِرُ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: And Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us: Abd ar-Razzaq informed me: Ibn Jurayj informed me, with this chain of narration, a similar narration.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1979 c, book 36, باب تَحْرِيمِ الْخَمْرِ وَبَيَانِ أَنَّهَا تَكُونُ مِنْ عَصِيرِ الْعِنَبِ وَمِنَ التَّمْرِ وَالْبُسْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ وَغَيْرِهَا مِمَّا يُسْكِرُ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ كَثِيرِ بْنِ عُفَيْرٍ أَبُو عُثْمَانَ الْمِصْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُسَيْنِ، بْنِ عَلِيٍّ أَنَّ حُسَيْنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَلِيًّا قَالَ كَانَتْ لِي شَارِفٌ مِنْ نَصِيبِي مِنَ الْمَغْنَمِ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَعْطَانِي شَارِفًا مِنَ الْخُمُسِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَلَمَّا أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَبْتَنِيَ بِفَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاعَدْتُ رَجُلاً صَوَّاغًا مِنْ بَنِي قَيْنُقَاعَ يَرْتَحِلُ مَعِيَ فَنَأْتِي بِإِذْخِرٍ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَبِيعَهُ مِنَ الصَّوَّاغِينَ فَأَسْتَعِينَ بِهِ فِي وَلِيمَةِ عُرْسِي فَبَيْنَا أَنَا أَجْمَعُ لِشَارِفَىَّ مَتَاعًا مِنَ الأَقْتَابِ وَالْغَرَائِرِ وَالْحِبَالِ وَشَارِفَاىَ مُنَاخَانِ إِلَى جَنْبِ حُجْرَةِ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ وَجَمَعْتُ حِينَ جَمَعْتُ مَا جَمَعْتُ فَإِذَا شَارِفَاىَ قَدِ اجْتُبَّتْ أَسْنِمَتُهُمَا وَبُقِرَتْ خَوَاصِرُهُمَا وَأُخِذَ مِنْ أَكْبَادِهِمَا فَلَمْ أَمْلِكْ عَيْنَىَّ حِينَ رَأَيْتُ ذَلِكَ الْمَنْظَرَ مِنْهُمَا قُلْتُ مَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا قَالُوا فَعَلَهُ حَمْزَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ وَهُوَ فِي هَذَا الْبَيْتِ فِي شَرْبٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ غَنَّتْهُ قَيْنَةٌ وَأَصْحَابَهُ فَقَالَتْ فِي غِنَائِهَا أَلاَ يَا حَمْزَ لِلشُّرُفِ النِّوَاءِ فَقَامَ حَمْزَةُ بِالسَّيْفِ فَاجْتَبَّ أَسْنِمَتَهُمَا وَبَقَرَ خَوَاصِرَهُمَا فَأَخَذَ مِنْ أَكْبَادِهِمَا قَالَ عَلِيٌّ فَانْطَلَقْتُ حَتَّى أَدْخُلَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعِنْدَهُ زَيْدُ بْنُ حَارِثَةَ - قَالَ - فَعَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي وَجْهِيَ الَّذِي لَقِيتُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا لَكَ ‏"‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهِ مَا رَأَيْتُ كَالْيَوْمِ قَطُّ عَدَا حَمْزَةُ عَلَى نَاقَتَىَّ فَاجْتَبَّ أَسْنِمَتَهُمَا وَبَقَرَ خَوَاصِرَهُمَا وَهَا هُوَ ذَا فِي بَيْتٍ مَعَهُ شَرْبٌ - قَالَ - فَدَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرِدَائِهِ فَارْتَدَاهُ ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَ يَمْشِي وَاتَّبَعْتُهُ أَنَا وَزَيْدُ بْنُ حَارِثَةَ حَتَّى جَاءَ الْبَابَ الَّذِي فِيهِ حَمْزَةُ فَاسْتَأْذَنَ فَأَذِنُوا لَهُ فَإِذَا هُمْ شَرْبٌ فَطَفِقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَلُومُ حَمْزَةَ فِيمَا فَعَلَ فَإِذَا حَمْزَةُ مُحْمَرَّةٌ عَيْنَاهُ فَنَظَرَ حَمْزَةُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ صَعَّدَ النَّظَرَ إِلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ ثُمَّ صَعَّدَ النَّظَرَ فَنَظَرَ إِلَى سُرَّتِهِ ثُمَّ صَعَّدَ النَّظَرَ فَنَظَرَ إِلَى وَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ حَمْزَةُ وَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ إِلاَّ عَبِيدٌ لأَبِي فَعَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ ثَمِلٌ فَنَكَصَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ الْقَهْقَرَى وَخَرَجَ وَخَرَجْنَا مَعَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: And Abu Bakr ibn Ishaq narrated to me: Sa'id ibn Kathir ibn Ufayr Abu Uthman al-Misri informed us: Abdallah ibn Wahb narrated to us: Yunus ibn Yazid narrated to me, from Ibn Shihab: Ali ibn Husayn ibn Ali informed me that Husayn ibn Ali informed him that Ali said: I had an old she-camel from my share of the spoils on the day of Badr, and the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) had given me another old she-camel from the fifth that day. When I intended to consummate my marriage with Fatimah, daughter of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), I made an arrangement with a goldsmith from Banu Qaynuqa' to travel with me so that we could bring idhkhir grass, which I intended to sell to the goldsmiths to help finance my wedding feast. While I was gathering equipment for my two she-camels of pack-saddles, sacks, and ropes, and my two she-camels were kneeling beside the room of a man of the Ansar, and having gathered what I had gathered, suddenly I found that both of my she-camels had their humps cut off, their flanks slashed open, and their livers taken out. I could not control my tears when I saw that sight of them. I said: "Who did this?" They said: "Hamzah ibn Abd al-Muttalib did it, and he is in this house in a drinking party of the Ansar; a singing-girl was singing to him and his companions, saying in her song: 'O Hamzah, come upon the plump she-camels!' So Hamzah leapt with the sword, chopped off their humps, slashed open their flanks, and took from their livers." Ali said: So I set off until I entered upon the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), while Zayd ibn Harithah was with him. He said: And the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) recognized in my face what I had encountered. The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "What is the matter with you?" I said: "O Messenger of Allah, by Allah, I have never seen the like of today! Hamzah attacked my two she-camels, chopped off their humps, slashed open their flanks, and here he is in a house with a drinking party." He said: So the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) called for his cloak, put it on, and set off walking, and Zayd ibn Harithah and I followed him until he came to the door where Hamzah was. He asked permission to enter, and they granted him permission, and behold, they were a drinking party. The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) began reproaching Hamzah for what he had done, but behold, Hamzah's eyes were bloodshot. Hamzah looked at the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), then raised his gaze to his knees, then raised his gaze to his navel, then raised his gaze to his face, and Hamzah said: "Are you anything other than slaves to my father?" The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) realized that he was drunk, so the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) stepped back on his heels, retreated backwards, and walked out, and we walked out with him.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1979 d, book 36, باب تَحْرِيمِ الْخَمْرِ وَبَيَانِ أَنَّهَا تَكُونُ مِنْ عَصِيرِ الْعِنَبِ وَمِنَ التَّمْرِ وَالْبُسْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ وَغَيْرِهَا مِمَّا يُسْكِرُ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قُهْزَاذَ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: And Muhammad ibn Abdillah ibn Quhzadh narrated it to me: Abdallah ibn Uthman narrated to me, from Abdallah ibn al-Mubarak, from Yunus, from az-Zuhri, with this chain of narration, a similar narration.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1980 a, book 36, باب تَحْرِيمِ الْخَمْرِ وَبَيَانِ أَنَّهَا تَكُونُ مِنْ عَصِيرِ الْعِنَبِ وَمِنَ التَّمْرِ وَالْبُسْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ وَغَيْرِهَا مِمَّا يُسْكِرُ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ الْعَتَكِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ - أَخْبَرَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ سَاقِيَ الْقَوْمِ يَوْمَ حُرِّمَتِ الْخَمْرُ فِي بَيْتِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ وَمَا شَرَابُهُمْ إِلاَّ الْفَضِيخُ الْبُسْرُ وَالتَّمْرُ ‏.‏ فَإِذَا مُنَادٍ يُنَادِي فَقَالَ اخْرُجْ فَانْظُرْ فَخَرَجْتُ فَإِذَا مُنَادٍ يُنَادِي أَلاَ إِنَّ الْخَمْرَ قَدْ حُرِّمَتْ - قَالَ - فَجَرَتْ فِي سِكَكِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَقَالَ لِي أَبُو طَلْحَةَ اخْرُجْ فَاهْرِقْهَا ‏.‏ فَهَرَقْتُهَا فَقَالُوا أَوْ قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ قُتِلَ فُلاَنٌ قُتِلَ فُلاَنٌ وَهِيَ فِي بُطُونِهِمْ - قَالَ فَلاَ أَدْرِي هُوَ مِنْ حَدِيثِ أَنَسٍ - فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ [quran sura="5" aya_start="93" aya_end="93"]‏{‏ لَيْسَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا طَعِمُوا إِذَا مَا اتَّقَوْا وَآمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ‏}‏
en_text: Abu ar-Rabi' Sulayman ibn Dawud al-Ataki narrated to me: Hammad—meaning Ibn Zayd—narrated to us: Thabit informed us, from Anas ibn Malik, who said: I was serving the people drink on the day wine was prohibited in the house of Abu Talhah, and their drink was nothing other than fadhikh: unripe dates and dried dates. Suddenly a caller was calling out, so he said: "Go out and see." So I went out, and behold, a caller was calling out: "Lo, wine has been prohibited!" He said: So it flowed through the alleyways of Medina. Then Abu Talhah said to me: "Go out and spill it." So I spilled it. Then they said—or some of them said—: "So-and-so was killed, so-and-so was killed while it was in their bellies"—he said: so I do not know if that was from the hadith of Anas—whereupon Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed: {There is no blame upon those who believe and do righteous deeds for what they consumed, provided they fear Allah, believe, and do righteous deeds} [Surah Al-Ma'idah, 5:93].

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1980 b, book 36, باب تَحْرِيمِ الْخَمْرِ وَبَيَانِ أَنَّهَا تَكُونُ مِنْ عَصِيرِ الْعِنَبِ وَمِنَ التَّمْرِ وَالْبُسْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ وَغَيْرِهَا مِمَّا يُسْكِرُ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ صُهَيْبٍ، قَالَ سَأَلُوا أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ عَنِ الْفَضِيخِ، فَقَالَ مَا كَانَتْ لَنَا خَمْرٌ غَيْرَ فَضِيخِكُمْ هَذَا الَّذِي تُسَمُّونَهُ الْفَضِيخَ إِنِّي لَقَائِمٌ أَسْقِيهَا أَبَا طَلْحَةَ وَأَبَا أَيُّوبَ وَرِجَالاً مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَيْتِنَا إِذْ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ هَلْ بَلَغَكُمُ الْخَبَرُ قُلْنَا لاَ قَالَ فَإِنَّ الْخَمْرَ قَدْ حُرِّمَتْ فَقَالَ يَا أَنَسُ أَرِقْ هَذِهِ الْقِلاَلَ قَالَ فَمَا رَاجَعُوهَا وَلاَ سَأَلُوا عَنْهَا بَعْدَ خَبَرِ الرَّجُلِ ‏.‏
en_text: And Yahya ibn Ayyub narrated to us: Ibn Ulayyah narrated to us: Abd al-Aziz ibn Suhayb informed us, who said: They asked Anas ibn Malik about al-fadhikh, and he said: We had no wine other than this fadhikh of yours that you call al-fadhikh. I was standing serving it to Abu Talhah, Abu Ayyub, and men from the companions of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) in our house, when a man came and said: "Has the news reached you?" We said: "No." He said: "Wine has been prohibited." So he said: "O Anas, pour out these jars." He said: And they never returned to it nor inquired about it after the news from that man.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1980 c, book 36, باب تَحْرِيمِ الْخَمْرِ وَبَيَانِ أَنَّهَا تَكُونُ مِنْ عَصِيرِ الْعِنَبِ وَمِنَ التَّمْرِ وَالْبُسْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ وَغَيْرِهَا مِمَّا يُسْكِرُ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ التَّيْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ إِنِّي لَقَائِمٌ عَلَى الْحَىِّ عَلَى عُمُومَتِي أَسْقِيهِمْ مِنْ فَضِيخٍ لَهُمْ وَأَنَا أَصْغَرُهُمْ سِنًّا فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ إِنَّهَا قَدْ حُرِّمَتِ الْخَمْرُ فَقَالُوا اكْفَأْهَا يَا أَنَسُ ‏.‏ فَكَفَأْتُهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لأَنَسٍ مَا هُوَ قَالَ بُسْرٌ وَرُطَبٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَنَسٍ كَانَتْ خَمْرَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ وَحَدَّثَنِي رَجُلٌ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ذَلِكَ أَيْضًا ‏.‏
en_text: And Yahya ibn Ayyub narrated to us: Ibn Ulayyah narrated to us; he said: And Sulayman at-Taymi informed us: Anas ibn Malik narrated to us, who said: I was standing serving the people of the clan—my paternal uncles—serving them from their fadhikh, while I was the youngest of them in age. A man came and said: "Indeed, wine has been prohibited." So they said: "Spill it, O Anas." So I spilled it. He said: I said to Anas: "What was it?" He said: "Unripe dates and fresh ripe dates." He said: Then Abu Bakr ibn Anas said: "It was their wine on that day." Sulayman said: And a man narrated to me from Anas ibn Malik that he said that as well.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1980 d, book 36, باب تَحْرِيمِ الْخَمْرِ وَبَيَانِ أَنَّهَا تَكُونُ مِنْ عَصِيرِ الْعِنَبِ وَمِنَ التَّمْرِ وَالْبُسْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ وَغَيْرِهَا مِمَّا يُسْكِرُ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ أَنَسٌ كُنْتُ قَائِمًا عَلَى الْحَىِّ أَسْقِيهِمْ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَنَسٍ كَانَ خَمْرَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ‏.‏ وَأَنَسٌ شَاهِدٌ فَلَمْ يُنْكِرْ أَنَسٌ ذَاكَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي بَعْضُ مَنْ كَانَ مَعِي أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسًا يَقُولُ كَانَ خَمْرَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Abd al-A'la narrated to us: al-Mu'tamir narrated to us, from his father, who said: Anas said: "I was standing serving the people of the clan..." a narration similar to the hadith of Ibn Ulayyah, except that he said: Abu Bakr ibn Anas said: "It was their wine on that day," while Anas was present and Anas did not deny that. And Ibn Abd al-A'la said: al-Mu'tamir narrated to us, from his father, who said: One of those who was with me narrated to me that he heard Anas saying: "It was their wine on that day."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1980 e, book 36, باب تَحْرِيمِ الْخَمْرِ وَبَيَانِ أَنَّهَا تَكُونُ مِنْ عَصِيرِ الْعِنَبِ وَمِنَ التَّمْرِ وَالْبُسْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ وَغَيْرِهَا مِمَّا يُسْكِرُ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَسْقِي أَبَا طَلْحَةَ وَأَبَا دُجَانَةَ وَمُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ فِي رَهْطٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا دَاخِلٌ فَقَالَ حَدَثَ خَبَرٌ نَزَلَ تَحْرِيمُ الْخَمْرِ ‏.‏ فَكَفَأْنَاهَا يَوْمَئِذٍ وَإِنَّهَا لَخَلِيطُ الْبُسْرِ وَالتَّمْرِ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ وَقَالَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ لَقَدْ حُرِّمَتِ الْخَمْرُ وَكَانَتْ عَامَّةُ خُمُورِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَلِيطَ الْبُسْرِ وَالتَّمْرِ ‏.‏
en_text: And Yahya ibn Ayyub narrated to us: Ibn Ulayyah narrated to us; he said: And Sa'id ibn Abi Arubah informed us, from Qatadah, from Anas ibn Malik, who said: I was serving Abu Talhah, Abu Dujanah, and Mu'adh ibn Jabal among a group of the Ansar, when someone entered upon us and said: "News has arrived: the prohibition of wine has been revealed." So on that day we spilled it, and it was a mixture of unripe dates and dried dates. Qatadah said: And Anas ibn Malik said: "Wine was indeed prohibited, and most of their wine on that day was a mixture of unripe dates and dried dates."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1980 f, book 36, باب تَحْرِيمِ الْخَمْرِ وَبَيَانِ أَنَّهَا تَكُونُ مِنْ عَصِيرِ الْعِنَبِ وَمِنَ التَّمْرِ وَالْبُسْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ وَغَيْرِهَا مِمَّا يُسْكِرُ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالُوا أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاذُ، بْنُ هِشَامٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ إِنِّي لأَسْقِي أَبَا طَلْحَةَ وَأَبَا دُجَانَةَ وَسُهَيْلَ ابْنَ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ مَزَادَةٍ فِيهَا خَلِيطُ بُسْرٍ وَتَمْرٍ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ سَعِيدٍ ‏.‏
en_text: And Abu Ghassan al-Misma'i, Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna, and Ibn Bashshar narrated to us—they said: Mu'adh ibn Hisham informed us: my father narrated to me, from Qatadah, from Anas ibn Malik, who said: I was indeed serving Abu Talhah, Abu Dujanah, and Suhayl ibn Bayda' from a large water skin containing a mixture of unripe dates and dried dates... a narration similar to the hadith of Sa'id.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1980 g, book 36, باب تَحْرِيمِ الْخَمْرِ وَبَيَانِ أَنَّهَا تَكُونُ مِنْ عَصِيرِ الْعِنَبِ وَمِنَ التَّمْرِ وَالْبُسْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ وَغَيْرِهَا مِمَّا يُسْكِرُ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ، عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ كُنْتُ أَسْقِي أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ بْنَ الْجَرَّاحِ وَأَبَا طَلْحَةَ وَأُبَىَّ بْنَ كَعْبٍ شَرَابًا مِنْ فَضِيخٍ وَتَمْرٍ فَأَتَاهُمْ آتٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّ الْخَمْرَ قَدْ حُرِّمَتْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ يَا أَنَسُ قُمْ إِلَى هَذِهِ الْجَرَّةِ فَاكْسِرْهَا ‏.‏ فَقُمْتُ إِلَى مِهْرَاسٍ لَنَا فَضَرَبْتُهَا بِأَسْفَلِهِ حَتَّى تَكَسَّرَتْ ‏.‏
en_text: And Abu at-Tahir narrated to me: Ibn Wahb informed us: Malik ibn Anas informed me, from Ishaq ibn Abdillah ibn Abi Talhah, from Anas ibn Malik, that he said: I was serving Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah, Abu Talhah, and Ubayy ibn Ka'b a drink made from fadhikh (unripe date wine) and dried dates, when a person came to them and said: "Indeed, wine has been prohibited." Abu Talhah said: "O Anas, get up and break this jar." So I went to a stone mortar of ours and struck it with the bottom of it until it broke.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1981, book 36, باب تَحْرِيمِ الْخَمْرِ وَبَيَانِ أَنَّهَا تَكُونُ مِنْ عَصِيرِ الْعِنَبِ وَمِنَ التَّمْرِ وَالْبُسْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ وَغَيْرِهَا مِمَّا يُسْكِرُ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ قَتَادَةَ بْنَ دِعَامَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى أَنْ يُخْلَطَ التَّمْرُ وَالزَّهْوُ ثُمَّ يُشْرَبَ وَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ كَانَ عَامَّةَ خُمُورِهِمْ يَوْمَ حُرِّمَتِ الْخَمْرُ ‏.‏
en_text: And Abu at-Tahir, Ahmad ibn Amr ibn Sarh narrated to me: Abdallah ibn Wahb informed us: Amr ibn al-Harith informed me that Qatadah ibn Di'amah narrated to him that he heard Anas ibn Malik saying: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade that dried dates and partially ripened dates (zahw) be mixed together and then drunk; and that was the common wine of theirs on the day wine was prohibited.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1982, book 36, باب تَحْرِيمِ الْخَمْرِ وَبَيَانِ أَنَّهَا تَكُونُ مِنْ عَصِيرِ الْعِنَبِ وَمِنَ التَّمْرِ وَالْبُسْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ وَغَيْرِهَا مِمَّا يُسْكِرُ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، - يَعْنِي الْحَنَفِيَّ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ لَقَدْ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ الآيَةَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ فِيهَا الْخَمْرَ وَمَا بِالْمَدِينَةِ شَرَابٌ يُشْرَبُ إِلاَّ مِنْ تَمْرٍ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us: Abu Bakr—meaning al-Hanafi—narrated to us: Abd al-Hamid ibn Ja'far narrated to us: my father narrated to me that he heard Anas ibn Malik saying: Allah indeed revealed the verse in which Allah prohibited wine, while in Medina there was no beverage being drunk except that made from dates.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1983, book 36, باب تَحْرِيمِ تَخْلِيلِ الْخَمْرِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ السُّدِّيِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبَّادٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُئِلَ عَنِ الْخَمْرِ تُتَّخَذُ خَلاًّ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us: Abd ar-Rahman ibn Mahdi informed us (H); and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us: Abd ar-Rahman narrated to us, from Sufyan, from as-Suddi, from Yahya ibn Abbad, from Anas: that the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) was asked about wine being turned into vinegar, and he said: "No."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1984, book 36, باب تَحْرِيمِ التَّدَاوِي بِالْخَمْرِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ وَائِلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، وَائِلٍ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ، أَنَّ طَارِقَ بْنَ سُوَيْدٍ الْجُعْفِيَّ، سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْخَمْرِ فَنَهَا أَوْ كَرِهَ أَنْ يَصْنَعَهَا فَقَالَ إِنَّمَا أَصْنَعُهَا لِلدَّوَاءِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ بِدَوَاءٍ وَلَكِنَّهُ دَاءٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us—and the wording is Ibn al-Muthanna's—they said: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Simak ibn Harb, from Alqamah ibn Wa'il, from his father, Wa'il al-Hadrami: that Tariq ibn Suwayd al-Ju'fi asked the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) about wine, and he forbade him or disliked that he should make it. Tariq said: "I only make it for medicine." So he said: "Indeed, it is not a medicine; rather, it is a disease."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1985 a, book 36, باب بَيَانِ أَنَّ جَمِيعَ مَا يُنْبَذُ مِمَّا يُتَّخَذُ مِنَ النَّخْلِ وَالْعِنَبِ يُسَمَّى خَمْرًا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ أَبِي، عُثْمَانَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الْخَمْرُ مِنْ هَاتَيْنِ الشَّجَرَتَيْنِ النَّخْلَةِ وَالْعِنَبَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me: Isma'il ibn Ibrahim narrated to us: al-Hajjaj ibn Abi Uthman informed us: Yahya ibn Abi Kathir narrated to me that Abu Kathir narrated to him, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Khamr is from these two trees: the date-palm and the grapevine."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1985 b, book 36, باب بَيَانِ أَنَّ جَمِيعَ مَا يُنْبَذُ مِمَّا يُتَّخَذُ مِنَ النَّخْلِ وَالْعِنَبِ يُسَمَّى خَمْرًا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَثِيرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ الْخَمْرُ مِنْ هَاتَيْنِ الشَّجَرَتَيْنِ النَّخْلَةِ وَالْعِنَبَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: And Muhammad ibn Abdillah ibn Numayr narrated to us: my father narrated to us: al-Awza'i narrated to us: Abu Kathir narrated to us, who said: I heard Abu Hurayrah saying: I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) saying: "Khamr is from these two plants: the date-palm and the grapevine."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1985 c, book 36, باب بَيَانِ أَنَّ جَمِيعَ مَا يُنْبَذُ مِمَّا يُتَّخَذُ مِنَ النَّخْلِ وَالْعِنَبِ يُسَمَّى خَمْرًا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، وَعِكْرِمَةَ، بْنِ عَمَّارٍ وَعُقْبَةَ بْنِ التَّوْأَمِ عَنْ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الْخَمْرُ مِنْ هَاتَيْنِ الشَّجَرَتَيْنِ الْكَرْمَةِ وَالنَّخْلَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي كُرَيْبٍ ‏"‏ الْكَرْمِ وَالنَّخْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: And Zuhayr ibn Harb and Abu Kurayb narrated to us—both saying: Waki' narrated to us, from al-Awza'i, Ikrimah ibn Ammar, and Uqbah ibn at-Taw'am, from Abu Kathir, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Khamr is from these two plants: the grapevine and the date-palm." And in the narration of Abu Kurayb: "the grapevines and the date-palms."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1986 a, book 36, باب كَرَاهَةِ انْتِبَاذِ التَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ مَخْلُوطَيْنِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، سَمِعْتُ عَطَاءَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى أَنْ يُخْلَطَ الزَّبِيبُ وَالتَّمْرُ وَالْبُسْرُ وَالتَّمْرُ ‏.‏
en_text: Shayban ibn Farrukh narrated to us: Jarir ibn Hazim narrated to us: I heard Ata' ibn Abi Rabah; Jabir ibn Abdillah al-Ansari narrated to us: that the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade mixing raisins and dried dates, and unripe dates and dried dates.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1986 b, book 36, باب كَرَاهَةِ انْتِبَاذِ التَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ مَخْلُوطَيْنِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى أَنْ يُنْبَذَ التَّمْرُ وَالزَّبِيبُ جَمِيعًا وَنَهَى أَنْ يُنْبَذَ الرُّطَبُ وَالْبُسْرُ جَمِيعًا ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: Layth narrated to us, from Ata' ibn Abi Rabah, from Jabir ibn Abdillah al-Ansari, from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace): that he forbade that dried dates and raisins be prepared together as nabidh, and forbade that fresh ripe dates and unripe dates be prepared together as nabidh.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1986 c, book 36, باب كَرَاهَةِ انْتِبَاذِ التَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ مَخْلُوطَيْنِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ رَافِعٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ، جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ قَالَ لِي عَطَاءٌ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَجْمَعُوا بَيْنَ الرُّطَبِ وَالْبُسْرِ وَبَيْنَ الزَّبِيبِ وَالتَّمْرِ نَبِيذًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: And Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me: Yahya ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj (H); and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and Muhammad ibn Rafi' narrated to us—and the wording is Ibn Rafi's—they said: Abd ar-Razzaq narrated to us: Ibn Jurayj informed us, who said: Ata' said to me: I heard Jabir ibn Abdillah saying: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Do not combine fresh ripe dates and unripe dates, nor raisins and dried dates, as nabidh."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1986 d, book 36, باب كَرَاهَةِ انْتِبَاذِ التَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ مَخْلُوطَيْنِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ الْمَكِّيِّ، مَوْلَى حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى أَنْ يُنْبَذَ الزَّبِيبُ وَالتَّمْرُ جَمِيعًا وَنَهَى أَنْ يُنْبَذَ الْبُسْرُ وَالرُّطَبُ جَمِيعًا ‏.‏
en_text: And Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: Layth narrated to us (H); and Muhammad ibn Rumh narrated to us: al-Layth informed us, from Abu az-Zubayr al-Makki, the freed slave of Hakim ibn Hizam, from Jabir ibn Abdillah al-Ansari, from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace): that he forbade that raisins and dried dates be prepared together as nabidh, and forbade that unripe dates and fresh ripe dates be prepared together as nabidh.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1987 a, book 36, باب كَرَاهَةِ انْتِبَاذِ التَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ مَخْلُوطَيْنِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنِ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ التَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ أَنْ يُخْلَطَ بَيْنَهُمَا وَعَنِ التَّمْرِ وَالْبُسْرِ أَنْ يُخْلَطَ بَيْنَهُمَا ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us: Yazid ibn Zuray' informed us, from at-Taymi, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Sa'id: that the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade mixing dried dates and raisins, and mixing dried dates and unripe dates.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1987 b, book 36, باب كَرَاهَةِ انْتِبَاذِ التَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ مَخْلُوطَيْنِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ أَبُو مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ نَهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ نَخْلِطَ بَيْنَ الزَّبِيبِ وَالتَّمْرِ وَأَنْ نَخْلِطَ الْبُسْرَ وَالتَّمْرَ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Ayyub narrated to us: Ibn Ulayyah narrated to us: Sa'id ibn Yazid Abu Maslamah narrated to us, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Sa'id, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade us to mix raisins and dried dates, and to mix unripe dates and dried dates.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1987 c, book 36, باب كَرَاهَةِ انْتِبَاذِ التَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ مَخْلُوطَيْنِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُفَضَّلٍ - عَنْ أَبِي، مَسْلَمَةَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: And Nasr ibn Ali al-Jahdhami narrated to us: Bishr—meaning Ibn Mufaddal—narrated to us, from Abu Maslamah, with this chain of narration, a similar narration.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1987 d, book 36, باب كَرَاهَةِ انْتِبَاذِ التَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ مَخْلُوطَيْنِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ الْعَبْدِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي، الْمُتَوَكِّلِ النَّاجِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ شَرِبَ النَّبِيذَ مِنْكُمْ فَلْيَشْرَبْهُ زَبِيبًا فَرْدًا أَوْ تَمْرًا فَرْدًا أَوْ بُسْرًا فَرْدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: And Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: Waki' narrated to us, from Isma'il ibn Muslim al-Abdi, from Abu al-Mutawakkil an-Naji, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Whoever among you drinks nabidh, let him drink it from raisins alone, or dried dates alone, or unripe dates alone."
